name: First Company: Introductory Business Simulation
description: Manage MiEmpresa, a small fashion accessories startup, making decisions about production, pricing, marketing, hiring, and cash management across 4 months. Learn fundamental business trade-offs: price vs. volume, fixed vs. variable costs, and cash vs. profit.
